**[P2] Clean up the entry-point factory that fails validation**

An entry point can resolve to an opted-in factory with constructor-owned resources but an invalid `create_plugin` signature or a raising descriptor. Validation fails before `_resolve_configured_factories()` appends that candidate, so the outer rejection handler never calls its `on_registration_result(False)`. An imported singleton can therefore retain workers or open resources after handler initialization fails. Include loaded candidates in rejection cleanup before validating them, ensuring each is notified once, and add a regression checking the failing candidate's own resource is released.
